title: Example Lunch & Learn
intro: A reference site for contributors. It shows the format every site here follows, and its two articles explain how to publish your own.

topics.title: Publishing a Lunch & Learn here
topics.summary: What to send, where it goes, and what your articles can contain.

lessons.title: Start here: what you send
lessons.blurb: One folder with a site.json and a Markdown file per article, sent as a pull request.

lessons.title: What an article can contain
lessons.blurb: Headings, code, tables, images and links, and what is left out on purpose.
